dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: #Ah, you've arrived, {NICKNAME}. I couldn't help but notice how busy you are these days...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: If you could manage to find the time to sit and enjoy an opera together or share a pot of tea... Taking a moment to slow down and enjoy the finer things in life is always beneficial to your body and soul.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, you needn't worry. Everything here seems to be in good order, not to mention the delightful scenery. I think I will have no issue residing in such a pleasant place.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I have a habit of going to an open space every morning to rehearse my voice.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It can be difficult to find a suitable place where my singing won't disturb anyone in Liyue Harbor, but here that is not a problem at all.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Yes. Why, that's a fundamental part of anyone's routine in my profession.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: If you skip a day, only you will know. But if you skip three days, the whole audience will know. A master never forgets the fundamentals of practicing.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: *sigh* Alright, I can see it written on your face already, "That sounds exhausting"... As a matter of fact, I don't feel that way at all, quite the opposite, really.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: To fully deliver the elegance of Liyue opera to the audience, we must strive for excellence, properly performing every subtlety in the story.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: To be completely honest, I find great enjoyment in my hours of practice.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I understand.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Great. Thank you for your kind understanding.

choices.text: Shall I accompany you while you rehearse?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Haha, how kind. I do appreciate your courtesy.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: However, in my practice routine, I tend to go over my whole repertoire, both singing and reciting... I may suddenly be acting dreadfully mournful one moment, and then practicing a hysterical laugh the next... I fear such a kaleidoscope of outright emotion may scare you.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I would much prefer to offer you a complete and fully prepared opera instead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, that would be perfect. I've been meaning to ask for your guidance on many things.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: It's just that you've traveled extensively... you have much experience for me to draw upon.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I must respect you if I wish to gain from your experience.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Ahem, to be completely honest... There are times I have considered giving up the opera and taking time to travel around faraway nations. But things are always busy in the troupe and I've just never found the right opportunity.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: After traveling to so many places, I'm sure that you've learned many different customs. Would you mind sharing some with me?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: For example, the swordplay of the Knights in Mondstadt, what's that like? Does it differ from that of the martial artists we see in Liyue?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I've also heard that the swords produced in Inazuma can cut through nearly anything... How do they forge such sharp swords?

choices.text: The knights of Mondstadt are masters of Favonius Bladework.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: A fighting style that flows like the wind? I wonder, are they capable of even manipulating the wind in combat?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I want to hear all that you have to say! It truly is fascinating.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I'll be sure to prepare some more questions for the next time we talk.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Of course, I'll be sure to make our conversations worth your time as well. I will prepare an appropriate gift for you as thanks for answering my questions.

choices.text: The smithies in Inazuma forge their blades from Jade Steel...

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Oh, that must be a very special material, then... It's no wonder that the people of Inazuma are reputedly confident in their craftsmanship.

choices.text: You're so formal sometimes, Yun Jin.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Haha, is this humor of yours also something that you've acquired throughout your travels?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Then I won't beat around the bush.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, now that you mention it... there is one thing I have been meaning to do.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: When I was a child, my father often told me legends of the adepti. I remember that one legend in particular made mention of an adeptus's abode in Jueyun Karst.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: An adeptus's abode?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right. The legend had it that adepti could drift upon beams of light, ride lightning, and leap into the sky to ascend to their abode.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: "From their lofty dwelling, they gaze to and fro. Drifting over land and sea, they know not the world below."

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: My father would have a mesmerized look on his face whenever we got to that part of the story.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: But though the story has been passed down all these years, no one has yet to ever see such an abode...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It has always been my dream to go and see such a place one day.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I would even like to perform an opera there, letting adepti and people alike hear my voice echoing through the lands.

choices.text: I think I know of a place like the one you've described.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: No... Really?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Ahem... I mean... I know that your words are sincere, it's just that you answered so quickly, and I haven't even decided what opera to perform or what costume to prepare...

choices.text: Take your time to think it over.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Thank you very much! That's most kind of you.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Alright, I have some ideas. I think for the performance, I will sing a selection about you and your dealings with the adepti...

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: As for the costume, I was hoping you could give me some creative input.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You have a deal!

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Alright, it's settled. I'll start practicing today... Actually, why not start right away — no time like the present! I must make sure this performance turns out perfect.

choices.text: I'll take you there once you've made up your mind.
We could just go to Qingyun Peak...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Yun Jin.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Good morning. Will you be departing for adventures in a distant land today?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Let's just hope that the weather will hold up with no rain or storms, and that you can go speedily about your way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Yun Jin.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: #Yes, good night, {NICKNAME}! It is good to turn in early from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The night markets are always worth a visit though, perhaps we can save that for tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Hmm, would you look at that... the name of this room is the "Feiyun Study Room."

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Its name contains the word "yun," just like my own name... It looks like I have a special connection with this room.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm kidding, of course. It is most definitely to my liking, though. Furnished with all the supplies one could possibly hope for in a study. I am truly grateful.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I always love to take a stroll around the night market after a performance.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: This street has a striking resemblance to those back in Liyue. It really feels just like being there.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Let's take a stroll around here tonight, then. What do you say?
